text: Hello, boys and girls, nice to see you again.Today we are going to talk about things I know from an outing.Please prepare student's book, workbook, and a pencil.Are you ready for the class?Let's begin.First, let's check the homework.Please open your book and turn to page 64.Read your passage about the park.Now, let's go.I think you can do it very well.Now, let's review the sounds.Please listen and read after the recording.Here we go.t c e-e-r ear dear beer e-a-r ear tear near yearNow, let's do some exercises.Please try to find the words with the sounds you hear.Now try number one.aCan you find the words?Yes, they are garden and star.Number two.oWhat are the words?Yes, they are glue and noodle.Number three.eYes, they are nurse and birthday.Number four.oWhat are they?Yes, August and tall.Number five.eYes, they are reed and sheep.The last one.iYes, they are chair and hear.You can do it very well.Now, let's listen and read some sentences.While reading, please pay attention to the intonation.First, WH question.Whose is this?Whose is that?Whose are these?Whose are those?It's they are.Now, alternative question.Is it all?Go on.What do you like?I like apples.Do you like red ones or green ones?I like red ones.Now, please try to read the sentences by yourself.You can read very well.Look, Alice, Kitty, Ben and Tom are having an outing in the park.They take food, fruit, drink and other things to the park.What food do they take?Please read after me.Alice takes some bread.It tastes soft.Tom takes some biscuits.They taste crunchy.Ben takes some cakes.They taste sweet.So, what fruit do they take?Let's try together.Alice takes some plums.They taste sweet and sour.Tom takes some cherries.They taste juicy.Ben takes some strawberries.So, what drink do they take?Now, you try.Well done.What about other things?What other things do they take?You try to talk about it by yourself.You did a good job.The park is very beautiful.What can you see?What can you hear?And what can you touch in the park?Let me try first.I can see tall trees.They are green.I can hear a fountain.It is quiet.I can touch the grass.It is soft.What a nice park.I like it.The children are having a good time in the park.Look, here comes that little dog.Dogs are cute.I like dogs.Me too.I have many books about dogs.Here is a book about dogs.Here is one of them.What is this book about?Can we read it together?Of course.This is Alice's book.It is about dogs.Let's read with the children.First, let's read the title.Dogs are color blind.Read after me.Color blind.Please read and think.What can we know from the passage?This mind map will help you.As we know, dogs are color blind.So, what cannot dogs do?But, what are dogs good at?Be good at.Then, what about other animals?Please try to find the answers in the passage.Now, take out your workbook.Turn to page 24.Please think about the three questions and read an underline.Now, we go.Now, let's talk about the mind map.Question 1.I think you can find the answer.Let's read.They cannot see colors.In a dog's eyes, everything is black, white and gray.Yes, dogs can run very fast.They can hear and smell very well too.Yes, lions, tigers, cats, cows and sheep are all color blind.But, monkeys can see colors.Many birds, fish and insects can see colors too.Next, let's do exercises.Please write down the words on your workbook.Dogs are man's good friend.Some dogs are big and some dogs are small.Dogs are very clever but they cannot see colors.They are color blind.How can a dog hunt for food then?Dogs can run very fast.Many animals cannot see colors.Lions, tigers, cats, cows and sheep are all color blind.Very nice reading.Thank you.Today, we know more about dogs.Let's talk about it, shall we?So, they cannot see colors.But, dogs can run very fast.Now, we know more about dogs.I feel happy.What about you?What about Alice and her friends?We enjoy nice food.We enjoy beautiful things.We know more about nature.What a happy outing!After class, please finish the following exercises.Are you clear?So much for today.Goodbye.
